big: Nifty Healthcare is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Healthcare track?
The Nifty Healthcare Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the Healthcare companies. It holds 20 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
